entries.title: Lifeline

emulation.notes: Lifeline is playable on PCSX2, but the intended experience depends on voice input; verify microphone passthrough before committing to a full playthrough.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 presentation with optional emulator-side improvements, constrained by voice-recognition compatibility.

primary.why: The North American PS2 release is the best English-language version of Lifeline, preserving the voice-command survival-horror design while making the game playable in English.
primary.how_to_play: Play the North American PS2 disc on compatible hardware with a working PS2-compatible USB headset, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy and confirmed microphone setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern rerelease was identified; the game relies on microphone voice recognition and may be sensitive to headset compatibility.
